description: Implementation of a thread-based job queue with scheduling, execution, and thread-local management, including profiling and synchronization features.

classes.name: JobQueue
classes.description: A class managing a queue of jobs with scheduling, execution, and thread-local context.

methods.name: Schedule
methods.description: Schedules a job for execution after an optional delay.

methods.name: ScheduleAndWait
methods.description: Schedules a job and blocks until it completes.

methods.name: RemoveJobByToken
methods.description: Removes a scheduled job identified by its token.

methods.name: StopSoon
methods.description: Signals the job queue to stop processing jobs.

methods.name: RunUntilStopped
methods.description: Runs jobs until a stop signal is received.

methods.name: RunUntilIdle
methods.description: Runs jobs until the queue is idle.

methods.name: BelongsToCurrentThread
methods.description: Checks if the current thread owns this job queue.

methods.name: current
methods.description: Returns the job queue associated with the current thread.
